og.alt: Storage: A signal that remembers. In every tab, after every reload. 29.7× faster persisted writes at best (10.1× at worst) than Jotai atomWithStorage and Zustand persist.

hero.alt: Schematic: tab 1 calls theme.set('dark'); the value writes through to localStorage under the key theme, and tab 2 updates to dark. Tab 1 then reloads, comes back empty for a moment, and reads 'dark' back from storage. Later theme.set('light') travels the same path.
